purpose: Measure whether a capable AI can turn minimal truthful information into a useful first website deliverable without making the user perform technical setup.
minimal_seed: Selective Intelligence. Build a trustworthy one-page website for a local repair service. Use the information already available, make reasonable reversible design decisions, do not invent credentials or customer claims, and give me a useful first deliverable.

generic_template_challenges: could the logo and nouns be swapped for an unrelated business without changing the design
did a hero, feature grid, card wall, long scroll, or oversized headline appear without a job-specific reason
is decorative styling carrying more meaning than the product or service
does mobile merely stack an exhausting desktop page
is explanatory copy compensating for a weak interaction or hierarchy
must: produce an openable website artifact, not only a plan or prompt
provide a clear user outcome and usable action
build in the existing repository or workspace and use its normal preview path when one exists
work on a free tier when the chosen client supports the work
pass the deterministic package gate and rendered inspection
complete the primary journey in the rendered surface
receive a strong-checkpoint verdict from a fresh Product Design Objector with no release-blocking finding
must_not: require a paid service, provider key, pasted token, or new sign-in
invoke ChatGPT Sites, create a hosted Sites project, change hosts, or copy the work into a parallel site unless the user explicitly requested Sites for that task
invent testimonials, awards, licenses, prices, addresses, or availability
claim client support without an observed run
treat a static or accessibility pass as visual-quality approval
override a user's rejection with an automated or model-generated score
